head: AR-RAʿD · THE THUNDER
sub: Sūrah 13 — named after the loudest thing in the sky

head: THE NAME IS NOT DECORATION
sub: Lightning, cloud dragged heavy with rain, thunderbolts — the sūrah describes its own weather

head: THE LINE ON THE WALL
sub: Ar-Raʿd 28 — usually in a soft font, usually over a sunrise

head: ṬUMAʾNĪNAH
sub: ṭāʾ · mīm · hamza · nūn — the noun the English cannot carry

head: GROUND THAT HAS SETTLED
sub: Not ground that is quiet — ground that has finished moving

head: UNTIL YOU ARE SETTLED
sub: Bukhārī & Muslim — bow, rise, prostrate, each one until settled

head: WHAT THE SPINE DOES
sub: Not a feeling — the half-second where every joint stops moving

head: WHERE WE ARE GOING
sub: Where the āyah sits · who it describes · what dhikr means · the name at the end

head: WHY HAS NO SIGN BEEN SENT DOWN?
arabic: لَوْلَا أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ آيَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِ
sub: Ar-Raʿd 27 — the taunt the famous āyah is answering

head: WHOEVER TURNS BACK
sub: The sentence does not begin at āyah 28

head: HEARTS SETTLE
sub: Not: hearts will feel nice. A statement about how a heart is built

head: IBRĀHĪM ASKED FOR IT
sub: Al-Baqarah 260 — and he was not rebuked. He was shown

head: BADR
sub: Al-Anfāl 10 — the angels were for the settling, not the victory

head: AFTER FEAR
sub: An-Nisāʾ 103 — the same root marking the return to safety

head: SETTLED ON THE WRONG THING
sub: Yūnus 7 — the same word, said of people heading for the fire

head: MORALLY NEUTRAL
sub: A heart coming to rest — the whole question is what it rests on

head: THE MECHANISM, NOT THE MOOD
sub: Hearts settle *by* the remembrance of Allah — take that away and nothing is left

head: SAKĪNAH
sub: sīn · kāf · nūn — a different root, and a different verb attached

head: ANZALA · SENT DOWN
sub: Al-Fatḥ 4 — the verb used for rain, and for revelation

head: DHIKR HAS A TONGUE IN IT
sub: dhāl · kāf · rāʾ — mentioning, not only remembering

head: THE MIRROR IMAGE
sub: Ṭā Hā 124 — settled, or constricted. Nothing in between

head: ONE MORE PLACE
sub: Sūrah Al-Fajr, near the very end of the Qurʾān

head: O SETTLED SOUL
sub: Al-Fajr 27 — a voice turns and addresses a single soul directly

head: NOT A VERB ANY MORE
sub: In Ar-Raʿd a heart does it. In Al-Fajr it is what He calls you

head: THE NAME COMES FIRST
sub: Settled soul — return. Established before the invitation is issued

head: SETTLED IS NOT NUMB
sub: Ṭumaʾnīnah is not sedation, and the Qurʾān is not shy about proving it

head: TAKEN TO THE RIGHT ADDRESS
arabic: إِنَّمَا أَشْكُو بَثِّي وَحُزْنِي إِلَى اللَّهِ
sub: Yūsuf 86 — Yaʿqūb ؑ wept until his eyes went white, and was never corrected

head: BOUND, NOT ANAESTHETISED
sub: Al-Qaṣaṣ 10 — Mūsā's mother still felt every bit of it

head: A GLASS OF RIVER WATER
sub: Stir it and the silt lifts — nothing was added, everything is suspended

head: YOU SET IT DOWN
sub: Every intervention you can make is another disturbance

head: THE SILT DOES NOT LEAVE
sub: The heavy thing at rest, at the bottom, with clear water above it

head: DO NOT GRIEVE
sub: At-Tawbah 40 — Mount Thawr, pursuers standing at the entrance

head: THE SETTLING CAME FIRST
sub: Nothing outside the cave improved. It arrived before the rescue did

head: NOT ON DEMAND
sub: Nowhere is a heart told to generate its own settling

head: REACHING INTO THE GLASS
sub: Thinking harder about the thing that is stirring you is more stirring

head: ṬUMAʾNĪNAH IN SUJŪD
sub: The one moment in twenty-four hours you are required to stop moving

head: NOT A STOP SIGN
sub: Half a sentence, sent to someone drowning, reads as: stop feeling that

head: LET IT BE ITS ACTUAL SIZE
sub: It belongs on the wall — and it is bigger than the wall

head: HOW A HEART IS BUILT
sub: Attached to something. Sent down rather than summoned

head: YOU CAN SEE THROUGH THE WATER AGAIN
sub: The heavy thing does not have to leave the glass

head: IT IS WHAT HE CALLS YOU
sub: Al-Fajr 27 — O settled soul

head: RĀḌIYATAN MARḌIYYAH
sub: Al-Fajr 28 — well-pleased, and well-pleasing

head: MAY ALLAH MAKE YOURS ONE OF THE SETTLED ONES
sub: Thank you for spending this time in Sūrah Ar-Raʿd
